let readPair line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)

    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)

  }

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = List.fold (fun acc x -> add x acc) Leaf [55, 10, 21, 18, 58, 51, 52]
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt
print (sumT tree)
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l
print (minT tree)
let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsOf k tree) [55, 53, 6])
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))

  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = [54, 19, 29, 28, 2] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l
print (minT root)
let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt
print (sumOf root)
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT root)

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
let show e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{show a} * {show b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{show a}"
let shrink e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT root)
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf

    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)

  match e:
    case Num n: n

    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 vars

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = List.fold (fun acc x -> insert x acc) Leaf [49, 6, 19, 15, 8, 42, 21, 2, 45]
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf root)
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT root)
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT root)

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n

  }

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = [15, 42, 27, 10, 26] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt
